title: Unit 4 Test
subtitle: Family · my / your / his / her / our / their · ’s · have / has

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences. Use my, your, his, her, our, or their.

items.q: I’m Sevara. ______ brother is a doctor.
Bobur is a student. ______ school is in Andijan.
We’re from Fergana. ______ house is big.
Zarina has a cat. ______ cat is black.
Tom and Lisa are teachers. ______ students are nice.

sections.title: B. Read about the family. Complete the sentences.
sections.passage: Rustam and Dilfuza are married. They have three children: two sons, Sardor and Jamshid, and one daughter, Madina. Madina is married to Alisher. They have a baby girl, Lola.

sections.title: C. Look at the family again and answer the questions.
D. Complete the sentences. Write have or has.

items.q: I ______ a sister and two brothers.
We ______ a small flat in the city.
Our teacher ______ a lot of books.

sections.title: E. Complete the text. Write has, have, is, or are.
sections.passage: My uncle Botir ___(1) a farmer. He ___(2) a big house in the village. His children ___(3) at school now. His wife ___(4) a nice garden, and they ___(5) a lot of animals.

sections.title: F. Complete the telephone conversation. Choose the correct answer.

items.q: A: Hello, 456 7890.  B: Hello. ______ Aziza there, please?
B: Hi! It’s Komil. ______ are you?

sections.title: G. Read the text and answer the questions.
sections.passage: Hi, I’m Daniel. I’m a bus driver. I have a wife and two children. My wife’s name is Rosa. She’s a nurse. Our son, Max, is 9 and his favourite sport is football. Our daughter, Mia, is 6. Her favourite food is pizza.
